scenes.title: Scoped project portfolio
scenes.interaction: Filter active projects, search Global Retail, select the project, and open Project 360.

scenes.title: Project and commercial 360
scenes.interaction: Select an amendment, inspect accepted commercial lines, drill into the work plan, and continue to the roster.

scenes.title: Project resource roster
scenes.interaction: Filter billing resources, search Riya, inspect an allocation, and open practitioner Resource 360.

scenes.title: Project economics
scenes.interaction: Filter approved budgets, select the current version, and expose approval and policy evidence.

scenes.title: Actuals reconciliation
scenes.interaction: Filter submitted timesheets, select a weekly sheet, and run the eight-hour daily-cap validation.

scenes.title: Dynamic delivery plan
scenes.interaction: Filter Build work, select a WBS item, isolate the critical path, and open related risks.

scenes.title: Risk and action board
scenes.interaction: Filter high mitigating risks, select one, and record an accountable acknowledgement.

scenes.title: Effective-dated allocation history
scenes.interaction: Select a practitioner and compare allocation versions, publication evidence and capacity states.
